records.rationale: The sdcardfs driver and registration were explicitly retired by a96c98dd7a30, as audited in sdcardfs-retirement-review.json. Final ACK and port no longer request SDCARD_FS. Keep that retirement; do not resurrect the obsolete filesystem merely because this historical config enabled it. That report includes positive vold FUSE selection and acknowledges remaining legacy sdcardfs userspace support. Only the selected x86_64 GKI kernel and its virtual-device module build are verified; architecture-specific/Cuttlefish/Microdroid/crashdump config hunks in this candidate do not select a second kernel target. No native LTS implementation is replaced by this configuration decision.

Keep FS_VERITY=y and BUILTIN_SIGNATURES=n. GrapheneOS VerityUtils positively enables fs-verity without a signature and verifies detached signatures against a supplied trusted certificate in userspace. This removes the optional in-kernel signature verification policy, not Merkle integrity verification. Retain the native filesystem/verity implementation and existing Android trust-policy split; runtime signature validation was not executed. Only the selected x86_64 GKI kernel and its virtual-device module build are verified; architecture-specific/Cuttlefish/Microdroid/crashdump config hunks in this candidate do not select a second kernel target. review_method: Read all original CONFIG changes and surrounding patch contexts; examine complete unique remerge delta separately. Validate add/revert by exact whole-file equality and reorder by parsed-map equality. Compare final ACK/port defconfigs and effective build-155 common/virtual configurations; symbols absent from defconfig are not assumed disabled. Native Kconfig and relevant interface code examined.
scope: 28 finalized config candidates. 002e9fb54954 (PKVM_INTEL) remains provisional pending protected virtualization implementation review; config-only cleanup does not decide that issue. No new source change or new build in this batch.
